headline: Driving Transparency in Programmatic CTV
subheadline: Building cleaner, faster, and more efficient connections between video supply and programmatic demand.

mission.title: Our Mission
mission.body: At Mira Media, we believe programmatic video advertising should be transparent, fast, and free of middleman bloat. We act as a lean supply-mediation network, providing direct technology bridges between high-quality streaming environments and the world's leading programmatic buyers.

principles.title: Clean Supply Paths
principles.body: We eliminate unnecessary intermediaries to ensure publishers retain maximum yield while buyers get clear inventory origin tracking.

principles.title: Technical Performance
principles.body: Our infrastructure is engineered for speed, offering low-latency VAST routing and OpenRTB 2.5/3.0 protocol execution.

principles.title: Strict Compliance
principles.body: Fully supporting IAB standards including sellers.json and app-ads.txt to maintain verified trust across the ecosystem.
